description: Source code for an Android InputMethodService implementation named AutofillImeService, which manages inline suggestions, keyboard view, and autofill features for an autofill keyboard app.

classes.name: AutofillImeService
classes.description: Main class implementing an Android InputMethodService with inline suggestion handling and autofill features.

classes.name: SuggestionItem
classes.description: Data class representing a suggestion view and its pinned status.

classes.name: ResponseState
classes.description: Enum representing the state of inline suggestion response handling.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Creates and initializes the input view, including keyboard and suggestion strips.

methods.name: onStartInput
methods.description: Handles input start, initializes decoder, resets keyboard, and updates response state.

methods.name: onFinishInput
methods.description: Handles input finish event.

methods.name: cancelPendingResponse
methods.description: Cancels any pending inline suggestion response callback.

methods.name: postPendingResponse
methods.description: Posts a callback to handle inline suggestions response.

methods.name: cancelDelayedDeletion
methods.description: Cancels scheduled inline suggestion deletion.

methods.name: scheduleDelayedDeletion
methods.description: Schedules delayed deletion of inline suggestions to prevent flicker.

methods.name: clearInlineSuggestionStrip
methods.description: Clears all inline suggestions from the UI.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Handles input view start event.

methods.name: onFinishInputView
methods.description: Handles input view finish event, clears suggestions if not finishing input.

methods.name: onComputeInsets
methods.description: Adjusts input method insets.

methods.name: onCreateInlineSuggestionsRequest
methods.description: Creates inline suggestions request with style and presentation specifications.

methods.name: toPixel
methods.description: Converts dp units to pixels.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns height dimension for inline suggestions.

methods.name: onInlineSuggestionsResponse
methods.description: Handles inline suggestions response, cancels delayed deletion, and updates suggestions.

methods.name: updateInlineSuggestionStrip
methods.description: Updates the UI with a list of suggestion items, managing pinned and scrollable suggestions.

methods.name: rescheduleShowcaseBgFgTransitions
methods.description: Reschedules background/foreground transition animations for suggestions.

methods.name: rescheduleShowcaseUpDownTransitions
methods.description: Reschedules up/down transition animations for suggestions.

methods.name: inflateThenShowSuggestions
methods.description: Inflates inline suggestions asynchronously and updates the UI when ready.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles custom data input, decodes and applies it via Decoder.
